verdicts.reason: The two are nearly pixel-identical. Both crop the background to a blurry, upscaled corner with the glasses. That throws away the laptops and desk props that gave the original its context. A huge black arc floats as the dominant shape in the dead upper half, while the search-bar headline, subline and CTA are packed into the bottom third. The lower arc sits awkwardly beside the CTA and subline, competing with them. The only difference is that B's small arc is very slightly smaller and tighter, which is not enough to separate them.
